description: Northwest Meditation Center is a Theravada Buddhist center.
introduction: Step away from the pace of daily life and spend time in a supportive setting shaped by the Theravada Buddhist tradition.
welcomeText: We welcome people interested in spending a few days in a quiet, supportive Buddhist community.
shortRetreatText: A three-day retreat for time away, practice, and reflection.
longRetreatText: A five-day retreat with more time to settle into the retreat rhythm.
retreatNote: Join us for quiet reflection and time in community.
